description: The lessons check, as a nudge. In a repo whose PLAYBOOK.md has '## The lessons check', an apply_patch edit, a git commit or a git push is denied until the agent has written a visible 'Lessons checked:' line in this turn, after its last commit or push, and, in the session's own repo, where its dev/lessons.mjs is this plugin's version, run a lookup with it. In other repos it does nothing. It reads the target repo's PLAYBOOK.md and dev/lessons.mjs and the session's rollout file, writes nothing and starts no program. Any error lets the call through. LESSONS_GATE=off in Codex's environment turns it off, and so does turning the hook off in /hooks. The command finds the hook from PLUGIN_ROOT and does nothing unless that is a full local path, so it works the same in PowerShell 7, cmd and sh, and prints only the hook's answer. Its first step stops cmd from running a 'node' file in the repo's folder in place of Node; PowerShell and sh run it as a harmless 'set' and then run Node. Windows PowerShell 5.1 can't read it, so there the hook lets every call through.
